{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in the first night of the [[Hexscape Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the first mission for the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. The [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]], based on their attire, act as the referees for a soccer match. On one side there is [[Clive]], [[Isaak]] and [[Ruthie]] playing against many of the event's enemies. The [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] discuss information about the group while a match plays out. During this match the group can be seen dominating the enemies with ease. Afterwards, the cutscene ends and the match begins. This simply contains the trio talking between each other. ==Cutscene== [[File:Adidas Event Cutscene 1|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when it begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A soccer court is shown with five players on it and two referees. The players are [[Clive]], [[Ruthie]] and [[Isaak]] playing against the [[Soccer Speedy]] and [[Whistle]], with the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] as referees. A ball falls down from the sky and the show begins. Later, [[Ruthie]] is shown avoiding the [[Whistle]], causing it to slide into a wall. Afterwards, the camera shows a compilation of [[Clive]] saying "''Who's up next.''". It ends with the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] talking to eachother.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:AdidasMission1Opening.ogg|300px]]
''The screen shows a soccer ball court with the [[Whistle]], [[Soccer Speedy]], [[Ruthie]], [[Clive]] and [[Isaak]] plying against each other. The [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] seemingly act as referees.'' ''Camera now shows the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]].'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Is this the team? {{Color|Commander}}: That's them, undefeated for thirty years. ''Camera now shows the main trio.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: They say he has an incredible first touch. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: And that girl once left a defender so dizzy, those little cartoon birds flew around his head! ''The [[Whistle]] slides into [[Ruthie]]. She avoids him, leading to him crashing into the wall.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: And this guy... ''Camera now shows [[Clive]].'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: All he ever says is... ''A montage of shots begins.'' {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Who's up next? {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Who's up next? {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Who's up next? ''Camera now shows the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] again.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: They play win, or go home. And they've never gone home. {{Color|Commander}}: These kids are unstoppable! ''Camera now the trio again, with this being the final shot.''
